expert_explanation: The authors already provide reasonable justification on this in their introduction section, i.e., assuming plenty of training data for every task is hard to acquire in most real scenarios as getting large labeled datasets is often expensive and time-consuming. The motivation of this paper is that humans can learn new tasks continuously even only see a few examples, and the authors wanted to build a model that can also do so.
